sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE nodes AS SELECT * REPLACE(CASE WHEN json_type(props)='VARCHAR' THEN json_extract_string(props,'$')::JSON ELSE props END AS props) FROM read_json(?,format='newline_delimited',columns={'id': 'VARCHAR', 'label': 'VARCHAR', 'lunasai_layer': 'VARCHAR', 'name': 'VARCHAR', 'iri': 'VARCHAR', 'doi': 'VARCHAR', 'pmcid': 'VARCHAR', 'pmid': 'VARCHAR', 'journal': 'VARCHAR', 'url': 'VARCHAR', 'year': 'VARCHAR', 'openalex_id': 'VARCHAR', 'openalex_author_id': 'VARCHAR', 'orcid': 'VARCHAR', 'profile_orcid': 'VARCHAR', 'nct_id': 'VARCHAR', 'stub': 'BOOLEAN', 'pub_types': 'VARCHAR[]', 'mesh_major_topics': 'VARCHAR[]', 'props': 'JSON'})

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE e AS SELECT * FROM read_json(?,format='newline_delimited',columns={'id': 'VARCHAR', 'subject': 'VARCHAR', 'object': 'VARCHAR', 'type': 'VARCHAR', 'predicate': 'VARCHAR', 'original_predicate': 'VARCHAR', 'lunasai_layer': 'VARCHAR', 'study_aspect': 'VARCHAR', 'mesh_type': 'VARCHAR', 'mapping_method': 'VARCHAR', 'source_predicate': 'VARCHAR', 'publication_role': 'VARCHAR', 'reference_type': 'VARCHAR', 'source_system': 'VARCHAR', 'source_record_id': 'VARCHAR', 'source_row_id': 'VARCHAR', 'source_row_table': 'VARCHAR', 'assertion_id': 'VARCHAR', 'currentness_status': 'VARCHAR', 'source_url': 'VARCHAR', 'iri': 'VARCHAR', 'primary_knowledge_source': 'VARCHAR', 'agent_type': 'VARCHAR', 'knowledge_level': 'VARCHAR', 'provenance_id': 'VARCHAR', 'derivation': 'VARCHAR', 'match_status': 'VARCHAR', 'is_major_topic': 'BOOLEAN', 'depth': 'INTEGER', 'also_asserted_by_source_system': 'VARCHAR[]', 'profile_orcid_valid': 'BOOLEAN', 'publication_orcid_valid': 'BOOLEAN', 'identity_flags': 'VARCHAR[]', 'author_order': 'INTEGER'})
ATTACH ? AS base_build
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE base_build.c AS SELECT id,subject,object,predicate FROM e WHERE type='CITES'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE base_build.core AS SELECT id,subject article,object trial,coalesce(publication_role,reference_type) reference_type FROM e WHERE type='VALIDATED_BY'
DETACH base_build
ATTACH ? AS base (READ_ONLY)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE article AS SELECT *,coalesce(list_has_any(pub_types,['Practice Guideline','Guideline']),false) guideline,coalesce(list_contains(pub_types,'Systematic Review'),false) systematic_review,coalesce(list_has_any(pub_types,['Practice Guideline','Guideline','Systematic Review','Meta-Analysis','Review']),false) gr,CASE WHEN list_has_any(pub_types,['Practice Guideline','Guideline']) THEN 1 WHEN list_contains(pub_types,'Systematic Review') THEN 2 WHEN list_contains(pub_types,'Meta-Analysis') THEN 3 WHEN list_contains(pub_types,'Review') THEN 4 ELSE 5 END publication_priority FROM nodes WHERE label='Article'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE populations AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('with_stubs',false),('without_stubs',true)) p(population,exclude_stubs)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE stop(id VARCHAR,name VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO stop SELECT id,name FROM nodes WHERE label='MeSHConcept' AND name IN (SELECT unnest(?::VARCHAR[]))

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE am AS SELECT e.subject article,e.object descriptor,e.id edge_id,e.is_major_topic edge_major,e.is_major_topic major,CASE WHEN array_length(a.mesh_major_topics)>0 THEN list_contains(a.mesh_major_topics,d.name) ELSE NULL END node_label_major,CASE WHEN e.is_major_topic IS NOT NULL THEN 'edge_flag' ELSE 'unknown' END major_source,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stop s WHERE s.id=e.object) check_tag FROM e JOIN article a ON a.id=e.subject JOIN nodes d ON d.id=e.object AND d.label='MeSHConcept' WHERE e.type='HAS_MESH'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tm AS SELECT e.id,e.subject,e.object,e.is_major_topic edge_major FROM e JOIN nodes n ON n.id=e.subject AND n.label='MedlinePlus' WHERE e.type='HAS_MESH'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE trial_qualified AS SELECT * FROM e WHERE type='HAS_MESH' AND starts_with(subject,'clinicaltrials:')
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE trial_mesh AS SELECT * FROM trial_qualified WHERE study_aspect='condition' AND mesh_type='mesh-list'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE authorship AS SELECT * FROM e WHERE type='AUTHORED_BY'

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE hierarchy AS SELECT subject child,object parent,id edge_id,CASE WHEN type='HAS_BROADER' THEN 1 ELSE depth END depth,CASE WHEN type='HAS_BROADER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END priority,predicate FROM e WHERE type IN ('HAS_BROADER','HAS_BROADER_ANCESTOR')
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE incoming AS SELECT object article,count(DISTINCT subject) in_corpus_citations FROM base.c WHERE subject<>object GROUP BY object
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE modes AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('none',0),('one',1),('full',2)) t(mode,level)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE seeds(key VARCHAR,kind VARCHAR,id VARCHAR,area VARCHAR,term VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO seeds VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO seeds VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO seeds VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO seeds VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO seeds VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO seeds VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE query_terms AS SELECT DISTINCT s.key seed,m.descriptor query_descriptor FROM seeds s JOIN am m ON m.article=s.id WHERE s.kind='article' AND m.edge_major IS TRUE AND NOT m.check_tag UNION SELECT DISTINCT s.key,t.object FROM seeds s JOIN tm t ON t.subject=s.id WHERE s.kind='topic' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stop WHERE id=t.object)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE source_terms AS SELECT a.* FROM am a WHERE NOT check_tag AND (a.major OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM am x WHERE x.article=a.article AND x.major AND NOT x.check_tag))

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE profiles AS SELECT a.article,list(DISTINCT a.descriptor) indexed_terms,list(DISTINCT s.descriptor) FILTER(WHERE s.descriptor IS NOT NULL) source_terms FROM am a LEFT JOIN source_terms s ON s.article=a.article AND s.descriptor=a.descriptor WHERE NOT a.check_tag GROUP BY a.article

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE topic_expansion AS WITH q AS (SELECT DISTINCT subject topic,object descriptor FROM tm WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stop WHERE id=object)),raw AS (SELECT q.topic,q.descriptor query_descriptor,m.mode,q.descriptor matched_descriptor,0 distance,NULL::VARCHAR hierarchy_edge FROM q CROSS JOIN modes m UNION ALL SELECT q.topic,q.descriptor,m.mode,h.child,h.depth,h.edge_id FROM q JOIN hierarchy h ON h.parent=q.descriptor CROSS JOIN modes m WHERE (m.level=2 OR (m.level=1 AND h.priority=0)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stop WHERE id=h.child)) SELECT * FROM raw QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY topic,mode,query_descriptor,matched_descriptor ORDER BY distance,hierarchy_edge)=1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE result_links AS SELECT id,subject article,object trial,type,coalesce(publication_role,reference_type) role FROM e WHERE type IN ('VALIDATED_BY','CITES_BACKGROUND','HAS_DERIVED_PUBLICATION')
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE annotation_capability AS SELECT descriptor,bool_or(a.gr) gr,bool_or(a.gr AND m.edge_major) gr_major FROM am m JOIN article a ON a.id=m.article GROUP BY descriptor

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE analytics AS SELECT * FROM read_json(?,format='newline_delimited',columns={'id': 'VARCHAR', 'community_id': 'DOUBLE', 'community_id_coarse': 'DOUBLE', 'community_id_mesh': 'DOUBLE', 'community_size': 'DOUBLE', 'community_size_coarse': 'DOUBLE', 'community_size_mesh': 'DOUBLE', 'pagerank_score': 'DOUBLE', 'betweenness_score': 'DOUBLE'}) WHERE starts_with(id,'PMID:')
